## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Baseline strategy uses current params (qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline).
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 run is in-sample BS-synthetic over entire history; high overfit risk. OOS and real-fills needed for unbiased estimate.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no OOS window tested yet)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no real-fills validation yet)
5. **Failure modes:** Without OOS/real-fills, cannot assess worst day, max drawdown, or blow-up scenarios. BS-synthetic shows strategy loses on 4/29/5/01 and wins on 5/04, but may not hold OOS.
6. **Concentration:** BS-synthetic shows top5_pct=999.0 (near-total concentration on 5/04). Need OOS/real-fills to see if concentration improves.
